title: Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Skrach Uglogwee
start: Inspect Skrach Uglogwee in the banquet hall in Lumbridge Castle.
prereq_quests: Recipe for Disaster: Another Cook's Quest

ironman.t: 10 Smithing (to smelt an iron bar and smith the iron spit)

items.t: 1 Raw chompy (if you don't burn the food, only one is needed)
Ogre bow or Comp ogre bow
Ogre arrows or brutal arrows (bring extras or make more just in case you lose some)

recommended.t: Feathers (to make the arrows if you don't have enough)
Dramen Staff/Lunar Staff or completion of A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift (recommended for quick teleportation)
Having the Karamja lodestone activated is a quick way to get to Karamja
The gnome glider system is also a fast transportation method (glide to Lemantolly Undri)
Access to Yanille lodestone for easier transportation to Feldip Hills
Ardougne teleport (since you will need to travel to Karamja)
Amulet of glory (alternative teleportation to Karamja)
Ring of duelling (easier teleport to Feldip Hills if unable to use fairy rings)

rewards.t: Able to use the boat trip to travel between Karamja and Feldip Hills (you must pay a fee of chompies or exotic herbs that can be found on Karamja, such as rogue's purse)

The ability to hunt jubblies (counts for 1 point when hunting chompies, though provides more range experience when killed, and big bones as a drop when killed, and the raw jubbly gives more experience when cooked than a raw chompy)

steps.t: Inspect Skrach Uglogwee. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'm sure I can get some Jubbly Chompy. › 2 Oh Ok then, I guess I'll talk to Rantz.]
Head to Feldip Hills AKS and talk to Rantz to the north-east. [Chat: 1 I'm trying to free Skrach. Can you help? › 3 Ok, I'll do it.]
Follow the coast south and talk to Rantz. [Chat: 1 I guess this is the watery place. What now?]
Cut the roots of the old tree, carve it
Talk to Rantz. [Chat: 1 Okay, the boat's ready; now tell me how to get a jubbly.]
With a raw chompy, iron spit, and logs, teleport to the Karamja lodestone.
Head south until a row boat is seen along the western coast. Just south-east of the boat is a small tree with Rantz's arrow stuck in it.
p: The palm tree with Rantz's arrow stuck in it

steps.t: Use the iron spit on the raw chompy and light a fire just west of the small tree.
Cook the chompy on the fire.
Board the nearby ogre boat. [Chat: 1 Yes please, I'll get a lift back with you.]
Talk to Rantz. [Chat: 1 Okay, now tell me how to get jubbly.]
Make a balloon toad by using the following steps (it is advised to make a few in the event you burn the raw jubbly).

sub.t: Just west, fill your ogre bellows with swamp bubbles from the swamp, then use the bellows on a swamp toad.
Directly west or north-west of the swamp pool, mine a feldip swamp rock (near AKS).
With the rock, toad, and a ball of wool in your inventory, use the bellows on the bloated toad again to make a balloon toad (the bellows must be filled).

steps.t: Drop the balloon toad in the area where Rantz is.
When a jubbly bird appears, kill it with an ogre bow and pluck it.

sub.t: If a jubbly bird does not spawn by the time the balloon toad disappears, you will need to make another one.

steps.t: Head north to the ogre spit-roast fire and cook the raw jubbly. If you burn it, you must repeat the hunting process.
Return to Lumbridge Castle and Use cooked jubbly on Skrach.
